title: Experience becomes knowledge
odia: ଏ ସନ ମଳୁ, ଆର ସନକୁ ବଇଦ।
literal_meaning: A patient this year; a healer by next year.
meaning_odia: ନିଜେ କୌଣସି ଅବସ୍ଥା ଭୋଗିଲେ ସେ ବିଷୟରେ ଅଭିଜ୍ଞତା ହୁଏ। ଏ ବର୍ଷର ରୋଗୀ ଆର ବର୍ଷକୁ ବଇଦ ହେବାର ଚିତ୍ରରେ ଅନୁଭବରୁ ଜ୍ଞାନ ମିଳିବାର କଥା କୁହାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: Going through something can teach a person how it works. The verse compresses that learning into a reversal of roles: the patient becomes the healer. The inspected Odia Vasa gloss reads it as gaining knowledge through experience.
usage_example: After working through a difficult application process, someone can explain its steps to the next applicant. The saying could acknowledge knowledge acquired firsthand. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The contrast between this year and next year gives the change a compact time frame. ମଳୁ names the ill person and ବଇଦ the healer: the verse moves from receiving help to having knowledge that can help someone else.
